# A description of the data:
  Who originally recorded the data, and what was the method they used?
  The County Health Rankings & Roadmaps which is a program of the University of Wisconsin Health Institute. They got the   data from federal agencies that collects the data and compile all the county data together.
  
  What are the key variables in the data set and how are they related to your key questions? (You do not have to describe   unused variables.)
  The key variables would be life expectancy and the median household income. These two variables are the ones that we     are measuring. We also have fipscode, state, and county as the identifiers for the county. 
  
  
  What does a single row of the data set represent?
  A single row of data represents one US county
  
  
# An outline of a graph related to your question of interest:
  The graph will be a scatterplot with the median household income being the x-axis in dollars, and life expactancy on     the y-axis with years. We can have a regression line as well to show the relationship. 

# The type of inference method we are going to use:
  We will use a simple linear regression
